answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization derives centrality from trusted endorsements, weighted by reciprocity and transitive paths. Fresh sybil identities lack trusted external links, leaving them near-zero eigenvector centrality; multiplying identities cannot by itself pass consensus. Only a steady pulse of verified conduct can open the vault of influence, built crystal-clear over time.
